obfuscation_indicators: not predictable and can vary significantly
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, but highlights material exposure to commodity prices, depletion of oil and gas reserves, third-party operators, and variable timber and surface revenues. Fiscal 2022 results deteriorated to a net loss, partly due to substantial stock compensation expense and lower land-sale gains, although operating cash flow improved. Some strategic and operational outlook statements remain noncommittal and the excerpt contains duplicated boilerplate.
